items.title: CMP
clues: I am a pop-up for a good reason.
I ask visitors about their privacy choices.
I store those choices and share them with partners.
My name means consent management platform.
items.why: A CMP is the tool that collects and passes on consent.

items.title: Layout shift
clues: I happen when things appear late and push the page around.
Reserving space for ads can reduce me.
items.why: Layout shift is unexpected movement of page content while it loads.

items.title: Header bidding timeout
clues: Bidders must answer before I end.
Set me too long and the page slows down.
Set me too short and bidders miss the auction.
items.why: The timeout balances page speed against getting enough bids.
